core_question: How do I calculate my personal net worth?
answer_summary: List the current value of everything you own (cash, investments, property) as assets, list everything you owe (loans, credit card balances) as liabilities, and subtract total liabilities from total assets to get net worth.
persona: anxious and rambling; using casual slang
